documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Early-morning physical before her school day.

Since last year: seen by an outside gynecology group for infertility. Thyroid, prolactin and pituitary hormones normal, office ultrasound normal, HSG normal with open tubes, husband's semen analysis normal. Two clomiphene cycles did not result in pregnancy; challenge test in October showed normal ovarian reserve. Diagnosis unexplained infertility. She has decided to take a break from treatment and is not on anything. Periods remain regular with mild cramps that she manages without medication.

No other concerns. No new family history.
Allergies: NKDA.

Exam: well, pleasant. Vitals as recorded, weight steady. Thyroid normal. Heart and lungs normal. Abdomen soft, nontender. Pelvic: external genitalia normal, cervix without lesions, Pap collected; no adnexal tenderness or masses. Skin and extremities normal. PHQ-2 1, she says winter was long but mood is fine.

A/P:
1. Health maintenance: CBC, CMP, lipids. TSH given mother's thyroid disease and the fertility history (gyn checked it last summer, rechecking yearly is reasonable).
2. Cervical screening: Pap today, cytology only at 29.
3. Infertility, unexplained, treatment on hold: she knows to reconnect with gyn when ready.
4. Dysmenorrhea, mild: no treatment wanted.

Next physical in a year.

documents.title: Pap and blood work
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Nicole - your Pap is normal, so the next one is in three years. Blood counts, chemistries, cholesterol and thyroid were all normal as well.

documents.title: RE: Pap and blood work
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Great news, thanks for letting me know.

documents.title: Vaccine administration
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Came in for her yearly flu and COVID 2025-26 vaccines. No fever or illness. Given IM in each deltoid. No immediate reaction; she had a sore arm last year for about a day after the COVID shot, expects the same.

documents.title: Emergency department record
documents.author: emergency medicine
documents.body:
AREA HOSPITAL EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT - PROVIDER NOTE
Arrival 01/17/2026 14:10

CC: left lower abdominal pain

HPI: 30 yo F with a history of female infertility and a prior clomiphene citrate challenge test. Left-sided lower abdominal pain began suddenly this morning. Sharp, comes and goes, 6/10 at worst. LMP started 14 days ago, ordinary flow and length; cycles regular at 28 days. Not sexually active at present; uses no contraception. No STI history. Denies nausea, vomiting, fevers, dysuria, frequency.

PMH (per records): female infertility; clomiphene citrate challenge testing indication.
Meds: none. Allergies: NKDA.
FHx: MGM type 2 DM, mother hypothyroidism, father HTN; no infertility, endometriosis or early menopause in the family.
SHx: never smoker, no alcohol, math teacher.

Exam: VS within normal limits. Uncomfortable but nontoxic. Abdomen: mild LLQ tenderness on palpation; no rebound, no guarding. No CVA tenderness. Pelvic: normal external exam and cervix, no cervical motion tenderness, no adnexal tenderness or mass.

UA: leukocyte esterase, nitrite and blood all negative. Urine hCG negative.

MDM: well-appearing young woman with mid-cycle unilateral pain, benign exam and negative urine studies. No evidence of infection, stone or pregnancy-related cause.

Impression: left lower quadrant pain.
Disposition: discharged home in stable condition. Follow up with PCP this week; return for worsening pain, fever, vomiting or bleeding.

documents.title: ED record reviewed
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: ED record from Saturday reviewed. LLQ pain mid-cycle, exam and UA/hCG negative, sent home. Patient already messaged; follow-up booked.

documents.title: ER visit over the weekend
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi - I went to the ER Saturday with pain on my lower left side. They checked my urine and did an exam and said it all looked ok and to follow up with you. It's a lot better already. Do I need an appointment?

documents.title: RE: ER visit over the weekend
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Glad it's easing up. Yes, the doctor would like a quick follow-up. Booked you Friday 1/23 at 3:45. If the pain comes back strongly, or you get fever or vomiting before then, call us right away.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Office Visit - ED follow-up
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Follow-up after ED visit 1/17 for left lower abdominal pain. ED record reviewed: benign abdominal and pelvic exam, UA negative, urine pregnancy test negative, discharged.

The pain settled within two days and has not come back. No fever, bowel or urinary changes, no abnormal bleeding.

Meds: none. NKDA.

Exam: afebrile, vitals normal. Abdomen soft, nontender throughout including the left lower quadrant, no masses, normal bowel sounds.

A/P: Left lower quadrant pain, resolved. Timing at mid-cycle with a reassuring workup. No further testing now. Call if it recurs. Physical in March as planned.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
30 y/o here for her yearly exam.

Interval: ED visit in January for left lower quadrant pain, settled on its own, nothing since. Fertility treatment still on hold; she has not gone back to gyn. Cycles regular, mild cramps as before, nothing needing medication. No other new symptoms.

Meds: none. Allergies: no known drug allergies.
Family history unchanged. Never smoker, no alcohol.

Exam: well-appearing. Vitals reviewed, BMI stable around 22. Thyroid normal. Heart regular without murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Extremities without edema. Mood good, PHQ-2 0.

A/P:
1. Preventive care: CBC, BMP, lipids today. Pap next due 2028. Tdap due 2027. Vaccines current for this season.
2. Female infertility, unexplained, on pause: she can call gyn directly when ready.
3. Dysmenorrhea, mild, stable.

See her in a year.

documents.title: Results from your physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Nicole, your blood work from this week's physical is normal across the board. Have a good spring.
